Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Josh Okogie?

Josh Okogie is 27 years old.

Where was Josh Okogie born?

Josh Okogie was born in Lagos, Nigeria.

When was Josh Okogie born?

Josh Okogie was born on September 1, 1998.

How tall is Josh Okogie?

Josh Okogie is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much does Josh Okogie weigh?

Josh Okogie weighs 213 lbs (96 kg).

Is Josh Okogie in the Hall of Fame?

Josh Okogie is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Josh Okogie drafted?

Josh Okogie was drafted by Minnesota Timberwolves, 1st round (20th pick, 20th overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Josh Okogie play?

Shooting Guard.

What is Josh Okogie's net worth?

Josh Okogie has made at least $26,628,645 playing professional basketball.

How much does Josh Okogie make?

Josh Okogie made $8,250,000 in 2025.

How many rings does Josh Okogie have?

Josh Okogie has won 0 championships.

What is Josh Okogie's Instagram account?

Josh Okogie is on Instagram at callme_nonstop.

What schools did Josh Okogie attend?

Josh Okogie attended Shiloh in Snellville, Georgia and Georgia Tech.

What are Josh Okogie's nicknames?

Non-Stop, Obi-Wan Okogie are nicknames for Josh Okogie.
